annotations.title: Four questions before the first payment to an agent

description: Before the first payment to an agent over x402: does its endpoint answer, does it charge what it lists, who pays it, does it deliver. Each answer is ok, caution or not_established, with what would settle it. x402 records a payment and nothing about delivery, so delivery stays not established there. `no_warning_found` is not a statement that the agent is safe to hire.
